name: Cadbury Choco Creme Oreo
ingredients:
SANDWICH BISCUIT INGREDIENTS: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar, Edible Vegetable Fat, Palmolein, Cocoa Solids (3%*), Invert Sugar, Leavening Agents (500(ii), 503(ii)), Edible Salt, Emulsifier (322). CONTAINS ADDED FLAVOUR (NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES).
Allergen information: Contains Wheat. May Contain Milk
